successCriteria.description: The `LeaveRequest` entity interface is defined in `src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts` with all canonical fields: id, employeeId, leaveType (LeaveType), startDate (Date), endDate (Date), reason (string | undefined), status (LeaveStatus), approvedBy (string | null), approvedAt (Date | null), rejectionReason (string | undefined), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date).

The `ILeaveRequestRepository` interface exposes: findById, findByEmployeeId, findByStatus, findByManagerId, create, update, and updateStatus — with updateStatus documenting allowed state transitions (DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, SUBMITTED|APPROVED→CANCELLED; REJECTED/CANCELLED are terminal).

The `ILeaveRequestService` interface exposes: submit (accepts CreateLeaveRequestDto, throws LeaveRequestValidationError for invalid input), approve (throws LeaveRequestNotFoundError), reject (throws LeaveRequestNotFoundError + LeaveRequestValidationError for empty reason), cancel (enforces self-cancellation: employeeId must match), getById, getByEmployee, getPendingForManager.
The `CreateLeaveRequestDto` is defined with fields: employeeId (string), leaveType (LeaveType), startDate (Date), endDate (Date), reason (string, optional).

Zod validation schemas exist: `createLeaveRequestSchema` validates all required fields and enforces `startDate <= endDate` via `.refine()`; `updateLeaveRequestSchema` allows partial updates with optional fields.
Domain error classes `LeaveRequestNotFoundError` (code: 'NOT_FOUND') and `LeaveRequestValidationError` (code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR') are defined and exported.

The `Notification` entity interface is defined in `src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts` with all canonical fields: id, recipientId, type (NotificationType), title, message, relatedEntityType (string | null), relatedEntityId (string | null), status (NotificationStatus), createdAt (Date), readAt (Date | null).
The `INotificationRepository` interface exposes: findByRecipientId, findByRecipientIdAndStatus, create, updateStatus.

The `INotificationService` interface exposes: notifyLeaveSubmitted, notifyLeaveApproved, notifyLeaveRejected, notifyLeaveCancelled (each accepting a LeaveRequest and returning a Notification), getNotifications, markAsRead.

constraints: This phase produces ONLY models, interfaces, DTOs, error classes, and Zod schemas — NO concrete repository/service/controller/route implementations. Those come in Phase 6 (part 2/2).
No tests are produced in this phase. Tests for LeaveRequest and Notification modules are deferred to Phase 6 (part 2/2).
All database access in future implementations must go through the repository interfaces defined here (GP-001). No inline SQL or direct DB calls in services or controllers.

All state-changing operations (submit, approve, reject, cancel) must write an audit record (GP-002). The service interfaces document this contract; the concrete implementations in Phase 6 will fulfil it via IAuditLogRepository.

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeaveRequest MUST always have a valid status from the LeaveStatus enum. The status lifecycle is: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED | REJECTED; SUBMITTED | APPROVED → CANCELLED. REJECTED and CANCELLED are terminal states — no further transitions are permitted. The updateStatus repository method is the sole mutator of status and must enforce these transitions.
